senses.definition: n.m. Ez 1:8 1. fourth part. 2. pl. four sides;—
ר׳ cstr., fourth part, of shekel 1 S 9:8, of hin Ex 29:40.
in Ez, pl. sf. four sides (אַרְבַּעַת always preceding): רְבָעָיו Ez 43:16, רְבָעֶיהָ v 17; רִבְעֵיהֶם 1:8; 10:11, -הֶן 1:17.
